$comment: Spawn parameters (PLAN.md §4, §5, §10, §11; decision record 0004). Everything numeric about spawning lives here. Tiers: 0 Common, 1 Burnished, 2 Votive, 3 Funerary, 4 Anvil-touched (PLAN §7).

count.$comment: n = base + floor(log2(1 + poi_count) * per_log2_density); a village gets 3, a city centre 8. After local midnight in urban band 0..1 the count halves (PLAN §11 night dampening).

value.$comment: value_mul = clamp(sqrt(reference_density / (1 + poi_count)), 1, max_mul): the village monster is rarer and worth more (PLAN §10).

tiers.$comment: A shift of +1 moves 60% of each tier's mass one tier up; fractional shifts interpolate. value_shift = (value_mul - 1) * value_shift_per_mul.

ranks.$comment: Monster ranks (decision record 0004 amendment). Commons fill the count. At most one elite per cell per epoch, with the given chance. A boss appears only when the cell wins the boss roll against its six neighbours and the roll is under the chance, so no two adjacent cells hold a boss in one epoch. Floors are minimum tiers; value_mul multiplies the cell value.

authenticity.$comment: Per spawn: the chance of a Drift hybrid is 0 at purity >= grounded_min, 1 at purity <= drift_max, linear between, so night (lower purity) makes hybrids likely rather than universal (PLAN §5). A hybrid pairs the spawn civilization with the strongest other one. Three weights within confluence_spread of each other is Confluence for every spawn. Accessioned and Sited are decided at collapse from the player's fix (PLAN §7).

placement.$comment: A spawn sits within jitter_m of the centre of one non-excluded r10 child of its cell. A collapse must come from within interaction_range_m and within the spawn's epoch or the one after.

speed_gate.$comment: Non-negotiable 3. Two fixes from one device faster than this, at least min_interval_s apart, disable interaction for that device until a slower pair arrives.
